title: Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku 2nd Album
overview:
This time, I want you to protect it together with your friends.

Precious people, precious memories, a precious heart. There are so many things here worth protecting. Each and every one of them - the crystals of truth you built with your friends through countless hardships and moments of joy - never lose them, never let them go...

Once again, I want you to grab hold of HAPPY.

Back in the town of Enfield, you are the last remaining member of the Third Division Vigilante Corps, a group that once earned the town's trust by handling residents' complaints. Since the sudden death of its captain, morale and work have dried up, and you have one year to restore the corps to its former glory.

In this friendship-building simulation, recruit three companions, take on jobs together and build trust with the people of Enfield. You can also save and load your game during holidays.

- 1 player

今度は仲間と、守って欲しい。

大切な人、大切な思い出。大切な心。ここには守るべきものが、やまほどあります。そのひとつひとつのすべてを数々の苦労や喜びの瞬間の中で、仲間たちと築いた真実の結晶を、決して失わないように、決して手放さないように…

またひとつ、HAPPYをつかんで欲しい。
